statement: ∀ (p l : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (z : ZMod p), p ≠ 2 → Odd l → z^l=1 → z+z⁻¹ ≠ 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0013 · 排除奇阶单位根在首项中抵消
plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0013 · Exclude cancellation of the two leading root-of-unity terms

brief.zh: 若和为零则 z²=−1，进而阶整除 4，与奇阶及奇特征矛盾。
brief.en: A zero sum implies z²=−1. Its order would divide four and also the odd l.
